description: Drift — a calm, paper-and-ink personal cloud desktop. Shared frontend for StarOS builds 3 (Supabase) and 4 (Replit).
name: drift

scripts.build: node scripts/write-build-json.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-landing.mjs && node scripts/build-blog.mjs
scripts.test: node test/access-policy.test.mjs && node test/config-check.test.mjs && node test/i18n-parity.test.mjs && node test/login-id.test.mjs && node test/password-policy.test.mjs && node test/recovery.test.mjs && node test/tax-math.test.mjs
scripts.release: npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:bundle
